purpose: Teach: ウイング/システムズ/サイボウズ/光文社/ウンコ/丸出し/細木/小田急

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカー部でウイング、つまりウインガーだったろ
lines.en: Riku, you were a winger on the soccer team, right?
lines.style: Direct, testing tone. Leans in slightly. Casual challenge — she's checking if he remembers this about himself, or if she does.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、将来IT企業のシステムズ系に就職するって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You told me you were going to work in systems at an IT company, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet turn-it-back energy. Matter-of-fact recall. Not accusatory, just returning the serve — matching her directness with his own.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サイボウズのインターン応募してたな
lines.en: Riku, weren't you applying for that Cybozu internship?
lines.style: Knowing smile in the voice. Catching him in his own details. Warm tease — she's been paying attention too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、光文社の文庫本好きだったよな、桜
lines.en: You loved those Kobunsha paperbacks, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft return. He's not competing — just meeting her halfway. Genuine memory, held lightly. A little slower, a little softer than her pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、低学年の頃「ウンコ」連発してたよな
lines.en: Riku, you said the word "poop" constantly in middle school.
lines.style: Dry, quick. Almost a laugh underneath. She's not meanly digging — it's the kind of old embarrassment you can only say to someone who was there.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、海でお腹丸出しで日焼けしたろ、桜
lines.en: Your stomach was completely sunburned at the beach, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Half-laugh, half-accusation. Light. He's deflecting her embarrassment with his own — leveling the playing field. Brief, almost mischievous.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お祖母様が細木数子の占い好きだって言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, your grandmother loved that fortune teller Hosoki Kazuko, didn't she?
lines.style: Curious again. Probing deeper. She's moved past the personal stuff — now she's getting at the things that shaped him. Slower pace, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で小田急ロマンスカーに乗ったろ、桜
lines.en: Your family took the Odakyu Romance Car together once, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Warm, close. His defenses are lower now. He's remembering something fondly — family, simple moments. Soft entry, slight pause before her name, like he's inviting her into the memory.
